provision.quote: Certain discrepancies were noticed. Show cause notice was issued. Explanation was called for. Personal hearing was granted but not availed. Finally, order dated 30.08.2024 was passed by the first respondent under Sections 16(1), 16(2), 39, 9(3) and 50 of TNGST Act, 2017 and the tax, interest and penalty were determined to the tune of Rs.5,96,90,012/-.

financial_years.quote: The case on hand pertains to the assessment year 2019-20.

events.quote: Personal hearing was granted but not availed.

Finally, order dated 30.08.2024 was passed by the first respondent under Sections 16(1), 16(2), 39, 9(3) and 50 of TNGST Act, 2017 and the tax, interest and penalty were determined to the tune of Rs.5,96,90,012/-.
The appellant filed application dated 29.11.2024 under Section 161 of the TNGST Act, 2017 to rectify the order issued under Form GST DRC-07 dated 30.08.2024.
The application was rejected vide order dated 21.01.2025.

defects_argued.note: denial of personal hearing in rectification proceeding under section 161
defects_argued.quote: There is no requirement that before dismissing the rectification application, the authority must hear the applicant.

review.notes: Scope corrected: the judgment describes the substance of a non-fraud Section 73 adjudication (audit discrepancies, SCN, explanation, hearing opportunity, and determination of tax/interest/penalty), although it does not cite Section 73 by number. The Section 161 hearing complaint is defect_rejected and contested because the Court expressly disagreed with contrary decisions.
